definitions.explanation: A large white wading bird with black wing feathers. In Japan it died out in the wild in 1971 and has been reintroduced from Toyooka in Hyogo. Written {鸛|こうのとり} in kanji.

examples.japanese: コウノトリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいる→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: A stork is flying in the sky.

examples.japanese: コウノトリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧くる。

⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶滅|ぜつめつ}→絶滅：03756_zetsumetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧コウノトリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧⟦{飼育|しいく}→飼育：06422_shiiku⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{再|ふたた}び→再び：03600_futatabi⟧⟦{野生|やせい}→野生：14439_yasei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}された→戻す：02317_modosu⟧。
examples.english: The Oriental stork, once extinct in the wild, was returned to the wild through captive breeding.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- コウノトリ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{運|はこ}んで→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧くる: the stork brings (a baby) — the European legend, well known in Japan
- コウノトリ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{里|さと}→里：02214_sato⟧: the stork's home (Toyooka, Hyogo)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{鶴|つる}→鶴：04359_tsuru⟧: crane — another large white bird, often confused with the stork; the crane stands for long life, the stork for babies

CULTURAL NOTE:
The name was also given to Japan's unmanned cargo spacecraft to the International Space Station (HTV, こうのとり), as a carrier of precious cargo.
